entries.group: REASONING: constant-0 token class every reader takes as int(tk.get('reasoning') or 0)
entries.grounds: The dict at adapters.py:256-259 is the token report of the one finished step the OCR stream carries (:263 step_finish part.tokens, written at :264-265). The mutant drops the member `"reasoning": 0`, so the object holds input, output and cache only. Every reader of a step's token object asks for 'reasoning' by name with a default: client.read_session (client.py:74: `tk["output"] + int(tk.get("reasoning") or 0)`), usage.session_tokens (usage.py:64: `t["reasoning"] += int(tk.get("reasoning") or 0)`), c2_p9.py:425 and release_smoke.py:291 (the same expression); the blind check before each (client.py:69, usage.py:60) tests only 'input' and 'output' as ints, which the mutant keeps. `.get` of an absent key is None, `None or 0` is 0: exactly the constant the original writes. So the session record's tokens (adapters.py:267-269 via read_session), the budget (client.Budget.spend :96-98 -> read_session), the usage account and its USD (usage.py:64, :71: `t["reasoning"]` there indexes the CLASSES dict built at :49, always present) and `aisef verify`'s re-derivation (verify.py:87 builds the same Budget over the same streams) are identical under the mutant. What differs: the step_finish line's bytes in sessions/<story>.reviewer.<n>.jsonl (one member fewer) and therefore that file's sha256 in EVIDENCE.json (run.py:425-434: a digest of what was written, compared to no expected serialisation). An observable difference with no reader: AUDITED, not EQUIVALENT. Measured (2026-10-18 17:05-17:11 +07, module sha256 8457b7cb6d6384c8f93b8e6a382fa8814558c79439afde1bb5b0ddb163022ca5 after the build asserted the description): all 14 registered kill files PASS on the mutant, as the campaign recorded (c3-w2.record.json targets[0].results[93]: 14 files PASS, class SURVIVED); the unmutated copy passes the same 14 (test_v21_identity after closure-evidence/v2/release/LEDGERLOCK-PROJECT.json, which it reads at :51, was added to the tree: errors=7 without it, OK with it). No kill file fails on the mutant: the SURVIVED stands as measured.

entries.group: ORDER: a list the record carries whose order no consumer reads
entries.grounds:
`deleted` (adapters.py:272) is built from the same `mine` rows as `required` (:218): git's `diff -z --name-status --no-renames` rows (:211-217) in git's own order, read through the shared helper in text mode (orchestrate/workspace.py:64-71: encoding utf-8, errors=replace, universal newlines), filtered to status D. It goes to exactly one place: the session record `s` (:268-274) -> self.sessions (:275) -> RUN.json `sessions` (run.py:655, :663: only `text` is stripped) -> EVIDENCE.json's sha256 of RUN.json as written (run.py:425-434). Unlike `required` it is passed to no function: coverage() takes required/base/head/preview (:276-277; review_ocr.py:86-89 re-sorts its own copy of required), findings() takes output and required (:285; review_ocr.py:147). git grep of `deleted` over aisef2/ finds only this line (quality/vacuity.py:71,193 and relevance.py:59,202 hold a patch's own `deleted`, not the record's); over validation/ none reads a session's (reach.py:249-269 builds its own `deleted_files`). The mutant yields git's row order instead of sorted(): identical for valid, CR-free UTF-8 (tree order = full-path byte order = code-point order: the covered entry [13]'s 19-name measurement, and measured again here for the three SEPARATED names of test_v21_defects_ocr, U+0085/U+2028/U+2029: SAME), different where git's bytes and the decoded text disagree. Measured 2026-10-18 17:00 +07 on a scratch repository (names in the index only, through aisef2.orchestrate.workspace.git and the adapter's own parsing :211-218, rows filtered to D): names {a
z, ab, a\x0bc, a	q, m} deleted -> mutant ['app/a	q.py', 'app/a

b.py', 'app/m.py'] (the CR read as LF), sorted() ['app/a	q.py', 'app/a

Then one list of RUN.json (and its digest) is ordered differently: AUDITED, not EQUIVALENT. a carriage return in a path: the helper reads stdout in text mode (workspace.py:71), so CR becomes LF while git lists the row by its 0x0D byte: the mutant's order differs from sorted() for valid UTF-8 too (measured above: DIFFER). The T10 tests name a CR name as a defect of `required` (test_v21_defects_ocrz docstring); no test deletes two such names, and no reader depends on the order

an invalid UTF-8 byte in a path under core.quotepath=false: git lists it by its byte, the helper decodes it to U+FFFD (errors=replace), which sorts after 'é' as text and before it as bytes (measured above: DIFFER); no reader

names in git's order that are not in text order for valid, CR-free UTF-8: none ([13]'s 19 names; here the three SEPARATED names U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 under 'app/': SAME, which is why test_v21_defects_ocr.py:157's three-element sorted() comparison passes under the mutant)

a deleted path reaching a coverage reason or a finding: coverage() receives only `required` (a deleted file is never required, :219), so the order of `deleted` cannot move a reason (test_v21_kills3_T10c.py:200 asserts app/legacy.py absent from the reasons) and findings() carries `in_scope` from set(required) (review_ocr.py:153)
